cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Procvičení názvoslovného systému jednotlivých skupin organických, přírodních a makromolekulárních látek. Studenti by si měli na semináři osvojit poznatky získané na přednáškách z organické chemie a měli by se naučit je prakticky použít na jednoduchých příkladech.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Practicing of nomenclature system of individual groups of organic, natural and macromolecular compounds. Students should acquire knowledge learned in the lectures on the seminar and they should learn to apply it practically on simple examples.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Basic concepts of organic chemistry. (allowance 0/2) a.Bounds in organic compounds.b.The spatial arrangement of molecules.c.The course of organic reactions: induction and mesomer effect, homolysis and heterolysis, substrates and reagents, oxidation and reduction.d.Polyreactions.2.Nomenclature system of organic substances. (allowance 0/16) a.Hydrocarbons: Alkanes, cykloalkanes, alkenes, alkynes.b.Aromatic hydrocarbons.c.Hydroxy - alcohols and phenols.d.Ethers.e.Organic sulfur compounds.f.Organic nitrogen compounds.g.Carbonyl compounds: aldehydes, ketones and their derivatives (hemiacetals).h.Carboxylic acids: mono-, di-, tri-carboxylic acids, acid salts.i.Functional acid derivatives: acid halides, anhydrides, esters, amides, nitriles.j.Substituted acid derivatives: halogen, hydroxy, oxo, amino acids.k.Derivatives of carbonic acid.l.Heterocyclic substances.3.Nomenclature system of Natural Products. (allowance 0/8) a.Saccharides: monosaccharides, oligosaccharides and polysaccharides.b.Reactions of saccharides.c.Derivatives of saccharides, glycosides.d.Peptides.e.Nucleic acids.f.Lipids: simple and higher structures.g.Terpenes.4.Overview of nomenclature of macromolecular substances. (allowance 0/2) a.Polymers: polyolefins, polyhalogenolefins, vinyl polymers, acrylic acid polymers, vinylidenic polymers, polydienes.b.Polycondensates: polyethers, polyesters, polyamides, phenolic, aminoplasts.c.Polyadducts: polyurethanes.
